youtube.title: When Kepler texts Galileo and gets left on read 🔭 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Kepler vs Galileo: one wrote a whole book hyping the other... and got an anagram back. 🔭💀

Kepler begged for a telescope. Galileo sent them to dukes instead.

Who's the real GOAT of astronomy? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on 1610: Kepler publicly backed Galileo's Starry Messenger, Galileo sent telescopes to patrons, and sent Kepler a scrambled anagram that Kepler decoded as "Mars has twin moons" (it was about Saturn).

#galileo #kepler #astronomy #sciencehistory #historymemes #funnyhistory #shorts
